full_details: The almanac said new moon. You wrote nothing under it. At the Theatre, before the afternoon, Heminges said that on Saturday night he had set Friday as the Shrew and Saturday as Two Gentlemen, and that the leaf has the two days the other way. Today is Two Gentlemen, and you are in it. Tomorrow is the Shrew, and you are in that. He did not name your part in either, and you did not supply a name. You played in the gown you already had. The Rose had a Toy. You did not go. You did not copy anything at night. Saturday's supper is still a thing with nothing written for it.
one_sentence: The leaf put Two Gentlemen today and the Shrew tomorrow, and you played the day the leaf named.
title: The leaf reversed the two days
